summary: SafeVault Phase 2 Sprint 1 verification (frontend-only, static + regression E2E). All acceptance criteria met: drive.ts extended with the required new low-level ops preserving existing exports; folderManager.ts implemented per spec; storage.ts extended with 4 new K entries + DriveSubfolders + clearDriveCache; web guards in place; UI files untouched; VaultContext untouched; two UI-adjacent null-guards for readEncryptedLocal correctly added. TypeScript compile clean (npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck → exit 0). Metro bundler produces only pre-existing shadow*/expo-notifications warnings, no NEW errors. Regression E2E through login → onboarding → home → docs → add-wizard confirms no UI regressions.

drive.ts.findFileOnDrive_uses_q_with_escaped_quot: esc() replaces ' with \', clauses seeded with `trashed = false` when includeTrashed is falsy

folderManager.ts.lazy_category_folder_creation: ensureCategoryFolder is only called from ensureDocFolder / by external callers → lazy by construction

storage.ts.note_on_seeded_naming: Spec mentioned getSeeded/setSeeded but the pre-existing code uses isSeeded/markSeeded — this predates Sprint 1 and was not part of scope; naming preserved as-is.

static_inspection_results.VaultContext.tsx: No imports from './folderManager'. No FolderManager references. Still calls uploadToDrive directly. UNCHANGED as required.

web_guards.app/document/[id].tsx: line 85-86: cipher = await readEncryptedLocal(doc.localUri); if (!cipher) throw new Error('Local cache unavailable on this platform');

regression_e2e_results.tab bar tabs: tab-home / tab-timeline / tab-docs / tab-profile testIDs all present (count=1 each); switching blocked only while wizard modal was open, expected behaviour

typescript_compile: npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck → exit code 0, zero errors
metro_logs: Only pre-existing warnings: shadow* deprecation and [expo-notifications] web-push-token warnings. No new error-level messages.
critical_code_review_comments: drive.ts findFileOnDrive: `appProperties has { key='...' and value='...' }` syntax is a Drive v3 quirk — correct as-is, but consider adding a unit test once a token is available in Sprint 3.
folderManager.ts invalidateCache sets hydrated=true after reset (intentional per comment) — good, avoids a re-hydrate re-populating stale keys after clearDriveCache.
resumableUpload currently sends the body in a single PUT (documented). True chunked resume is deferred — acceptable for Sprint 1 scope.
Storage naming inconsistency (isSeeded/markSeeded vs spec's getSeeded/setSeeded) predates Sprint 1; no action needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 1 is a pure storage-layer sprint; VaultContext still calls uploadToDrive directly (no FolderManager integration yet — that lands in Sprint 3). Real Drive API paths (createFolderOnDrive, findFileOnDrive, updateFileOnDrive, downloadFromDrive, resumableUpload) cannot be exercised via web preview because a real Google OAuth token is required. Static inspection + UI regression is the correct verification for this sprint. All acceptance criteria met.
